svg.title: River rejuvenation
svg.desc: When base level falls, a river cuts down again: a knickpoint with a waterfall forms where the old and new long profiles meet and moves upstream, the old floodplain is left as paired river terraces, and meanders are cut down into incised meanders.

g.text: side view from source to mouth
waterfall where old and new profiles meet
old floodplain left high on both sides
after a second fall in base level
seen from above: the river cuts down but keeps its bends
